Normalization process analyzes schemas based on keys and on the functional dependencies among their attributes. A key constraint is a special case of a FD where the attributes in the key play the role of X and the set of all attributes play the role of Y. Consider a relation R (A, B, C, D), with the following set of functional dependencies over R: 
{A →B, B →C, CD →E} 

(a) Compute the keys for relation R. (5 marks)

(b) What is the primary key of relation R? (4 marks)

(c) Explain why normalization is based on functional dependencies. (4 marks)

(d) Consider a person entity. Write three functional dependencies that can exist in a person table. (4 marks)
